project.name: Illustrative ServiceNow external processing comparison
assumptions: All costs and capacity figures are invented for this example, not vendor quotes or performance benchmarks.
The catalog contains three architect-approved designs. Shared processing is permitted by the hypothetical isolation policy.
Capacity for the redundant options is assumed to hold under the required failure scenario.
The common platform subscription is excluded from every alternative; the comparison covers the same incremental scope.
Monthly costs are assumed constant for 24 months. All modeled one-time costs are included once.

capacity_jobs_per_min.description: Assumed sustainable processing capacity under the required scenario.

required_failover.description: One means this complete candidate is assumed to meet the required failover arrangement; this is not an availability calculation.

constraints.description: Support at least 100 jobs per minute under the required scenario.
Select a complete candidate qualified for the required failover arrangement.
